resources.string: Breathe In gently interrupts long scrolling sessions (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) with a short breathing break. It needs four permissions to do that.
To know which app is open and how long you\'ve used it today.
To show the breathing break on top of the app you\'re scrolling.
To tell Reels and Shorts apart from the rest of Instagram and YouTube. In Settings, open \"Breathe In feed detection\" and turn it on. It only checks which screen is open in those two apps.
To show that Breathe In is running.
